source: Written for this essay task in the style of the CAPS 'Writing and Presenting' skills for Grade 10 English. They are not official codes: replace them with the outcomes you teach to.

outcomes.text: Plan before writing: brainstorm ideas, choose the relevant ones and put them in order.
Develop each paragraph around one main idea, with a topic sentence and a specific example or detail.
Stay on the topic that was set and take a clear position on it.
Organise an essay with an introduction, logically ordered paragraphs and a conclusion.
Link sentences and paragraphs with connecting words and phrases.
Use correct grammar, spelling and punctuation, including capital letters and subject-verb agreement.
Choose vocabulary and a tone that suit a formal essay.
Edit and proofread a draft against a checklist before handing it in.
Identify the main components of a desktop PC and say what each one does.
Explain why components are installed in a set order: the motherboard first, power last.
Install the CPU and RAM in the correct socket and slots before any expansion card.
Fit expansion cards and storage in the correct slots and bays.
Connect the power supply last and check the build before switching on.
Plan a build in advance and complete it independently within the time allowed.
